completion:

**I. Data Gathering & Verification (Building from "Start with the monitoring records")**

1.  **Start with the Monitoring Records:**
    *   **Comprehensive Collection:** Gather *all* relevant monitoring data. This includes Continuous Emission Monitoring System (CEMS) data, periodic stack tests, ambient air monitoring data (near the facility), meteorological data (wind speed, wind direction, temperature, humidity), and any process data from the facility that could influence emissions (e.g., production rate, fuel type).  Don't just focus on the period of exceed
